Prometheus text format (0.0.4): per-container CPU, memory, network, block I/O, PIDs,
restarts, health and OOM kills, labelled `name`, `image`, `compose_project`,
`compose_service`; daemon uptime, containers by state, image count, build info and Go
runtime basics. nyxd `-metrics-listen ADDR` also serves it at `http://ADDR/metrics`.
